name: PeerPush

sources.title: PeerPush homepage including FAQ (submission flow, free queue, paid plans)
PeerPush - Pricing (linked from footer; plan details quoted in homepage FAQ)

conditions: Free submissions are real but 'join a publishing queue' - timing on the free path is not specified
Instant publishing requires a paid plan: Basic $39, Boosted $89, Max-Boosted $229 (one-time prices quoted in the site FAQ)
requirements: A free PeerPush account is required ('create a free account and click Submit Your Product')
Submit a product URL - PeerPush can auto-fill product details with AI, or fields can be completed manually
Structured product data: use cases, target audiences, platforms, pricing, alternatives, screenshots, description
preparation: Description, screenshots, pricing model, platform tags, alternative products
Decide free-queue vs paid instant publishing before submitting
workflow: Create a free account at peerpush.net ('Sign up' / 'Join 48,000+ builders')
Click 'Submit Your Product' and paste the product URL for AI auto-fill (or enter details manually)
Complete the structured fields - use cases, audiences, platforms, pricing, alternatives, screenshots
Free tier: submit and wait in the publishing queue; paid tiers (Basic $39 / Boosted $89 / Max-Boosted $229) publish instantly and add promotion
After publishing, engage with the community - the PeerPush score (upvotes, comments, mutual support) drives visibility and Product of the Day/Week/Month awards
watchFor: Free-queue wait time is undocumented - if launch timing matters, the paid Basic tier is the instant path
PeerPush also sells a separate 'Submit to 100 directories' service - don't confuse it with the on-site listing
Visibility compounds with community engagement (PeerPush score), not just the listing itself
The site advertises AI-assistant discoverability (MCP server, public API, crawler-friendly) - listing copy should be written for machine readability
countsAsLive: The product has a public PeerPush page (visible in Browse/Top/Recent) after clearing the free publishing queue or via instant paid publishing
unknowns: Length of the free publishing queue
Exact moderation criteria applied before a queued free listing goes live
Whether the outbound link is dofollow on live product pages
